imgDesc.text: During the "Material Placement" stage, use the "Multipurpose Excavation and Hauling Cutter" to arrange differently shaped Kresnik Kristalls from your "Stock" and build a path for the trapped miners to escape.

galleryCharacter.key: Ways to Rescue the Trapped Miners...

imgDesc.text:
Some enormous Kresnik Kristalls cannot be added directly to your "Stock."
In those cases, select Cutting Mode, then swipe along the cracks to plan your cuts. Once the cutting plan is complete, confirm the cut to divide the giant crystal pillar into several smaller pieces.
